_comment_install: GLOBAL install (~/.claude/settings.json): CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR does NOT expand here, so the path below is ABSOLUTE. Replace <you> with your Windows username. PROJECT install (.claude/settings.json): you may instead use ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/floating-prompt.exe.
_comment_setup: Single-file install: mkdir %USERPROFILE%\.claude\hooks  then copy floating-prompt.exe (built via cargo build --release) into it. The args form below skips shell quoting entirely - no PowerShell layer involved.
